claim_boundary.statement: The drawings establish source provenance and constrain the construction grammar. They do not by themselves define a permutation or prove adjacency preservation.

drawings.visual_inventory: Hand-drawn stage sequence from null through point, segment, open triangular form, closed triangular form, and a final two-face or filled-cell form.
Hand-drawn registered circular and rosette constructions using labels including i, 0, 1, x, y, z, and t.
Hand-drawn directed A-B-C turn and return construction with written procedural notes concerning motion, distance, turn, proportion, and closure.
Hand-drawn nested triangular incidence or development sketch with repeated internal subdivisions and labeled boundary points.
Hand-drawn three-arm spiral centered at i with the surrounding arms labeled x, y, z, and t.

provenance_statement: The author identifies this drawing sequence, together with the current synthesis, as the true source of the stages denoted t_1, t_2, and t_3.
title: Primary hand-drawing sources for the registered spiral synthesis
